description: Football matches being played right now, worldwide, with score and minute, grouped by competition (biggest competitions first). Optional filters by country or league key.

country.description: Only this country, in English (e.g. England, Spain, Brazil); international club and national-team competitions use Eurocups, International or WorldCup

format.description: text (default): compact summary with IDs and links. json: the raw data feed, minified and capped at 60,000 characters

language.description: Language for team, competition and country names, and for the football-mania.com links (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, pt-BR, nl, ar, ru, tr, id, …). Default: en

league_key.description: Only this competition (league key from search, e.g. EnglandPremierLeague)

timezone.description: IANA time zone for kick-off times and dates, e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Riyadh. Default: UTC

name: get_live_scores

awayScore.description: Goals for the away team; absent before kick-off

country.description: Country or confederation of the competition

homeScore.description: Goals for the home team; absent before kick-off

leagueKey.description: Competition key, usable with get_standings and get_league_fixtures

state.description: One of scheduled, live, finished, other

status.description: Raw status: a minute while live, FT/HT/Postp. otherwise, or the kick-off time

timezone.description: Time zone the kick-off times were rendered in

total.description: Matches found before any limit was applied
